executive_assessment.text: Hurricane Maria in 2017 severely damaged Dominica's infrastructure and economy, prompting a resilience-oriented reconstruction programme.
In the Kalinago Territory, climate hazards, forest degradation and livelihood vulnerability motivate integrated agriculture, watershed and Indigenous tourism support.
UNDP's recovery work includes gender-responsive planning, social protection and livelihood assessment for Kalinago communities.
